description: Two calculations: monthly data transfer and average speed for a website (visitors, pages per visit, page size), or how long a file takes to move at a given connection speed. Decimal units unless MiB, GiB or TiB are given.

file_size_unit.description: transfer: unit of file_size. Defaults to GB.

mode.description: website: monthly bandwidth of a site. transfer: time to download or upload a file.

page_size.description: website: average page size, in page_size_unit.

page_size_unit.description: website: unit of page_size. Defaults to MB.

redundancy.description: website: safety factor for spikes and bots, 1 or more. Defaults to 1.5.

speed_unit.description: transfer: unit of speed. Defaults to Mbps.

name: bandwidth_calculator
title: Bandwidth calculator
